# AMCOL Haulage & Logistics

> Nation wide transport, stand-by truck and trailer service, heavy haulage cargo, oversized cargo moves, heavy lifting services and hazardous, flammable and explosive cargo transport throughout Trinidad and Tobago.

AMCOL Haulage & Logistics is part of the AMCOL Group of Companies and provides transport and logistics support for industrial and commercial cargo. The company serves customers throughout Trinidad and Tobago from Penal.

## Core Services

- [Nation Wide Transport](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/nationwide-transport.html)
- [Stand-By Truck and Trailer Service](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/standby-truck-trailer-service.html)
- [Heavy Haulage Cargo](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/heavy-haulage-cargo.html)
- [Oversized Cargo Moves](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/oversized-cargo-moves.html)
- [Heavy Lifting Services](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/heavy-lifting-services.html)
- [Hazardous, Flammable and Explosive Cargo](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/hazardous-flammable-explosive-cargo.html)
- [Service Coverage](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/coverage.html)
- [Request a Quote](https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/request.html)
